title: Economic Growth Vs Economic Development
definition: Economic growth refers to the quantitative increase in a country's real output (GDP/GNP) over time, whereas economic development is a multi-dimensional qualitative process that includes growth along with structural changes, reduction in poverty, inequality, and unemployment, and enhancement of human well-being.
importanceInUpsc: This microtopic forms the foundational bedrock of Indian Economy in GS Paper III (Inclusive Growth, Mobilization of Resources, Development & Employment) and frequently appears in Prelims regarding the limitations of GDP, indices like HDI, and qualitative welfare metrics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Economic Growth Vs Economic Development.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic National Income Accounting (GDP, GNP, NNP)
